text.title: 最后一小时
text.situation:
三点时，前台安静了一些。玛雅的弟弟发消息，问她能否一起看电影。她可以离开，却选择放弃这次下午出游，留下最后一小时。这是她的选择，不是志愿者的规定。乔提醒她，帮忙并不意味着放弃每一个休闲下午。玛雅说，她想用这一小时完成承诺的事。

乔：你的做法似乎和早上不同了。
玛雅：是逐渐变的。我原以为每个问题都要立即回答。现在我的想法是先问、听，再核实。
乔：你能把空杯子送到厨房吗？
玛雅：乐意。
黑尔先生后来在日记里写，玛雅欣然且迅速地接下了这件小事。玛雅笑了笑，说这个词真正式，不过她喜欢便条里的暖意。

paragraphs.en: At three, the desk was quieter. Maya’s brother sent a message asking whether she could join him for a film. She could have left, but she chose to sacrifice the afternoon out and stay for the final hour. This was her choice, not a rule for volunteers. Jo reminded her that helping did not mean giving up every free afternoon. Maya said she wanted to devote this hour to finishing what she had promised.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Your approach seems to have changed since this morning.
Maya: Gradually. I thought every question needed an instant answer. Now my mindset is to ask, listen and check.
Jo: Could you take the empty cups to the kitchen?
Maya: Gladly.
Later, in his diary, Mr Hale wrote that Maya had accepted the small job with alacrity. Maya laughed at the formal word, but she liked the warmth of his note.

S11.O07.P01.cue: 解释玛雅放弃什么，以及留下做什么。
acceptableAnswers: 她放弃下午出游，用最后一小时帮忙。
她倾听并核实事情时，思维方式逐渐改变。

S11.O07.P03.cue: 用一个正式表达，描述她怎样接下小事。
acceptableAnswers: 她欣然且迅速地接下了。

S11.O07.T01.cue: 告诉同事你将怎样用一小时处理项目。
acceptableAnswers: 我可以用一小时核对细节。
